'''Hrchek Kal Fas''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Saurin]] [[droid]] trader active during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CVD" /> Fas was at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] when local farm boy [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived looking for a [[pilot]] to bring them to the planet [[Alderaan]].<ref name="Episode IV" />

==Personality and traits==
While Hrchek Kal Fas was a hard individual, he was smart by keeping his [[bodyguard]] with him when he was at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]].<ref name="CVD" />

==Equipment==
Kal Fas wore a green shirt, a tan jacket, silver gloves, dark blue pants, and a pair of black boots.<ref name="Episode IV" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hrchek Kal Fas first appeared in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] though was unnamed in the film.<ref name="Episode IV" /> He was played by an uncredited [[Laurie Goode]].<ref name="SW in the UK">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-in-the-uk-memorabilia-23-24-november-2013|text=''Star Wars'' in the UK: Memorabilia, 23-24 November 2013}}</ref> His name was first identified as [[canon]] in the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''; though not confirmed in the book, in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity he is the cousin of fellow [[Saurin]] [[Sai'torr Kal Fas/Legends|Sai'torr Kal Fas]].
